about: The staff perk catalogue (StaffPerks.swift). Every figure is a game design value, not taken from a source. `monthlyCost` is per covered person a month at the reference price level (scaled by the country's price level in code); with costBasis "wage" it is instead a share of each covered person's monthly pay. `groups` are the role groups a perk may be given to (who may get which perk). `quitFactor` multiplies the weekly quit odds of the people it covers, `pull` draws better applicants for the roles it covers, `tiredness` is the weekly relief a covered worker gets, `managerMood` the weekly lift of the manager's mood when the manager is covered, `worth` the share of its cost that people count as pay when they judge whether they are paid enough. The company car's cost and effect wiring belongs to the vehicles work; its entry only keeps the old figures.

perks.name: Company car
perks.detail: The manager and team leads drive one: they stay longer and the manager is happier.

perks.name: Gym membership
perks.detail: Fitter people: long weeks wear them down less.

perks.name: Health insurance
perks.detail: Private care: people feel looked after and better people apply.

perks.name: A team trip each year
perks.detail: A few days away together: people stay, and the manager is happier.

perks.name: Free lunch
perks.detail: Lunch together every day: people stay and long days are easier.
